firewall.name: Firewall_Block_ICMPv4_Echo
firewall.desc: Block inbound ICMPv4 echo requests (ping) on the firewall.
firewall.command: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv4 echo" protocol=icmpv4:8,any dir=in action=block
firewall.check: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv4 echo" | findstr /C:"Block"
firewall.revert: netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv4 echo"

firewall.name: Firewall_Block_ICMPv6_Echo
firewall.desc: Block inbound ICMPv6 echo requests on the firewall.
firewall.command: netsh advfirewall firewall add rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv6 echo" protocol=icmpv6:8,any dir=in action=block
firewall.check: netsh advfirewall firewall show rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv6 echo" | findstr /C:"Block"
firewall.revert: netsh advfirewall firewall delete rule name="grapheneX block ICMPv6 echo"

firewall.name: Firewall_Default_Block_Inbound
firewall.desc: Block inbound connections by default on every firewall profile.
firewall.command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy blockinbound,allowoutbound
firewall.revert: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles firewallpolicy allowinbound,allowoutbound
firewall.notes: Revert restores the Windows default policy (allow inbound).

firewall.name: Firewall_Default_Deny_Incoming
firewall.desc: Set the default inbound policy to deny while allowing outbound traffic.
firewall.notes: The previous /etc/default/ufw is backed up and restored on revert.

firewall.name: Firewall_Disable_File_Printer_Sharing
firewall.desc: Disable the built-in File and Printer Sharing firewall rules.
firewall.command: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="File and Printer Sharing" new enable=No
firewall.check: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "if (Get-NetFirewallRule -DisplayGroup 'File and Printer Sharing' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Enabled -eq 'True' }) { exit 1 }"
firewall.revert: netsh advfirewall firewall set rule group="File and Printer Sharing" new enable=Yes

firewall.name: Firewall_Enable_All_Profiles
firewall.desc: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for the domain, private and public profiles.
firewall.command: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state on
firewall.revert: netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off

firewall.name: Firewall_Enable_UFW
firewall.desc: Enable the Uncomplicated Firewall (ufw) and start it at boot.
firewall.notes: Revert stops ufw; rules you added yourself are kept on disk.

firewall.name: Firewall_Log_Low
firewall.desc: Log firewall events at the low level so blocked traffic is auditable.

user.name: Account_Inactive_Lock
user.desc: Disable accounts that have been inactive for 30 days by default.
user.notes: Applies to accounts created after this change; use chage -I 30 for existing accounts.

user.name: Account_Lockout_Threshold
user.desc: Lock accounts after five failed logon attempts.
user.check: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$o = net accounts; if ($o -match 'Lockout threshold:\s+(\d+)' -and [int]$Matches[1] -ge 1 -and [int]$Matches[1] -le 5) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"
user.notes: A lockout threshold of 0 means accounts never lock out.

user.name: Disable_AutoLogon
user.desc: Disable automatic logon and remove stored auto-logon credentials.
user.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v AutoAdminLogon /t REG_SZ /d 0 /f && reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon" /v DefaultPassword /f

user.name: Disable_Guest_Account
user.check: net user Guest | findstr /C:"Account active" | findstr /I "No"

user.name: Enable_UAC
user.desc: Enable User Account Control and keep it at the secure desktop prompt.
user.notes: Disabling UAC requires a restart; revert removes the policy value.

user.name: Home_Directory_Permissions
user.desc: Restrict home directories to owner access (750) and remove group/other write.
user.check: if find /home -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -type d -perm /027 | grep -q .; then exit 1; fi
user.notes: Original modes are recorded per directory and restored on revert.

user.name: Password_History
user.desc: Remember the last 24 passwords to prevent reuse.
user.check: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$o = net accounts; if ($o -match 'Password history is not enforced' -or ($o -match 'Length of password history maintained:\s+(\d+)' -and [int]$Matches[1] -ge 24)) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

user.name: Password_Max_Age
user.desc: Require passwords to be changed at least every 365 days.
user.notes: Existing accounts keep their current chage values; run chage -M 365 for each user if needed.

user.name: Password_MinLength
user.desc: Require a minimum password length of 14 characters.
user.check: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$o = net accounts; if ($o -match 'Minimum password length:\s+(\d+)' -and [int]$Matches[1] -ge 14) { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"

user.name: Password_Min_Age
user.desc: Prevent users from changing their password more than once per day.

user.name: Password_Quality_Complexity
user.desc: Require at least three of the four character classes (minclass = 3).

user.name: Password_Quality_MinLength
user.desc: Require passwords of at least 14 characters through pam_pwquality.

user.name: Password_Warn_Age
user.desc: Warn users seven days before their password expires.

user.name: Screen_Lock_Timeout
user.desc: Lock the desktop after 10 minutes and require a password on resume.
user.command: reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaveActive /t REG_SZ /d 1 /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaveTimeOut /t REG_SZ /d 600 /f && reg add "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaverIsSecure /t REG_SZ /d 1 /f
user.check: powershell -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command "$p='HKCU:\Control Panel\Desktop'; if ((Get-ItemProperty $p).ScreenSaveActive -eq '1' -and [int](Get-ItemProperty $p).ScreenSaveTimeOut -le 600 -and (Get-ItemProperty $p).ScreenSaverIsSecure -eq '1') { exit 0 } else { exit 1 }"
user.revert: reg delete "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaveActive /f && reg delete "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaveTimeOut /f && reg delete "HKCU\Control Panel\Desktop" /v ScreenSaverIsSecure /f

user.name: Shell_Idle_Timeout
user.desc: Log out interactive shells after 15 minutes of inactivity.
user.notes: The file did not exist before hardening, so revert deletes it again.

network.name: Disable_Teredo
network.desc: Disable the Teredo IPv6 transition tunnel.
network.command: netsh interface teredo set state disabled
network.check: netsh interface teredo show state | findstr /I "disabled"
network.revert: netsh interface teredo set state default

network.name: Disable_WDigest_Caching
network.desc: Stop the WDigest provider from caching plaintext credentials.

network.name: Network_Disable_IP_Forwarding
network.desc: Disable IPv4 forwarding on hosts that are not routers.
network.notes: Do not apply this on routers, VPN gateways or container hosts that need forwarding.

network.name: Network_Enable_RP_Filter
network.desc: Enable reverse path filtering to drop spoofed source addresses.
network.notes: The drop-in is removed by revert and sysctl --system reloads the previous values.

network.name: Network_Enable_SYN_Cookies
network.desc: Enable TCP SYN cookies to resist SYN flood attacks.

network.name: Network_Ignore_ICMP_Redirects
network.desc: Ignore ICMP redirects and do not send redirects.
network.check: sysctl -n net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects | grep -qvx '[01]' && exit 1; test "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects)" = 0 -a "$(sysctl -n net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects)" = 0

network.name: Network_Ignore_Router_Advertisements
network.desc: Ignore IPv6 router advertisements on hosts with static configuration.
network.notes: May break SLAAC; skip when IPv6 is configured automatically.

network.name: Network_Log_Martians
network.desc: Log packets with impossible source addresses (martians).

network.name: Require_NTLMv2
network.notes: Legacy appliances that only speak NTLMv1 will stop authenticating.

network.name: Require_SMB_Signing
network.desc: Require SMB packet signing for the SMB server.

network.name: SSH_Client_Strict_Host_Keys
network.desc: Make the SSH client refuse changed host keys and disable legacy options.
network.command:
install -d -m 0755 /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d && printf 'StrictHostKeyChecking ask
HashKnownHosts yes
ForwardAgent no
ForwardX11 no
Tunnel no
GSSAPIAuthentication no
' > /etc/ssh/ssh_config.d/99-graphenex-client.conf

network.name: SSH_Disable_Password_Authentication
network.desc: Require public key authentication for SSH logons.
network.notes: Verify that key-based access works in a second session before applying. Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

network.name: SSH_Disable_Root_Login
network.desc: Forbid direct root logon over SSH.
network.notes: Make sure an administrative account with sudo exists before applying. Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

network.name: SSH_Disable_Unused_Features
network.desc: Disable X11, agent, TCP and tunnel forwarding and empty passwords.
network.command:
install -d -m 0755 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d && printf 'PermitEmptyPasswords no
X11Forwarding no
AllowAgentForwarding no
AllowTcpForwarding no
PermitTunnel no
' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-graphenex-ssh-disable-unused-features.conf && sshd -t
network.notes: Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

network.name: SSH_Harden_Crypto
network.desc: Allow only modern ciphers, MACs and key exchange algorithms.
network.notes: Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

network.name: SSH_Session_Limits
network.desc: Limit authentication attempts, sessions and idle time.
network.notes: Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

network.name: SSH_Verbose_Logging
network.desc: Log SSH authentication details at VERBOSE level.
network.notes: Restart sshd (systemctl restart ssh) for the change to take effect.

services.name: Disable_Telnet_Client
services.desc: Remove the legacy Telnet client feature.

services.name: Enable_Defender_PUA
services.desc: Enable Defender protection against potentially unwanted applications.

services.name: Service_Disable_Avahi
services.check: if systemctl is-enabled --quiet avahi-daemon; then exit 1; fi
services.probe: systemctl is-enabled avahi-daemon 2>&1; systemctl is-active avahi-daemon 2>&1
services.notes: Rotate to the vendor default enabled state on revert; the pre-change state is recorded in the journal.

services.name: Service_Disable_Bluetooth
services.check: if systemctl is-enabled --quiet bluetooth; then exit 1; fi
services.probe: systemctl is-enabled bluetooth 2>&1; systemctl is-active bluetooth 2>&1
services.notes: Rotate to the vendor default enabled state on revert; the pre-change state is recorded in the journal.

services.name: Service_Disable_CUPS
services.check: if systemctl is-enabled --quiet cups; then exit 1; fi
services.probe: systemctl is-enabled cups 2>&1; systemctl is-active cups 2>&1
services.notes: Rotate to the vendor default enabled state on revert; the pre-change state is recorded in the journal.

services.name: Service_Disable_RPCBind
services.desc: Disable the rpcbind service (not needed on NFS clients).
services.check: if systemctl is-enabled --quiet rpcbind; then exit 1; fi
services.probe: systemctl is-enabled rpcbind 2>&1; systemctl is-active rpcbind 2>&1
services.notes: Rotate to the vendor default enabled state on revert; the pre-change state is recorded in the journal.

services.name: Service_Enable_Auditd
services.desc: Enable and start the Linux audit daemon.
services.check: systemctl is-enabled --quiet auditd && systemctl is-active --quiet auditd
services.probe: systemctl is-enabled auditd 2>&1; systemctl is-active auditd 2>&1
services.notes: Revert stops audit logging; the prior unit state is recorded in the journal.

services.name: Service_Enable_Time_Sync
services.desc: Enable systemd-timesyncd to keep the clock synchronised.
services.check: systemctl is-enabled --quiet systemd-timesyncd && systemctl is-active --quiet systemd-timesyncd

services.name: Service_Enable_Unattended_Upgrades
services.desc: Enable automatic security updates through unattended-upgrades.

kernel.name: Enable_DEP
kernel.desc: Require Data Execution Prevention for all applications.
kernel.notes: Windows defaults to OptIn; the probe records whether the setting was already present.

kernel.name: Enable_LSA_Protection
kernel.desc: Run LSASS as a protected process (RunAsPPL).
kernel.notes: Check third-party security agents for LSA protection compatibility before applying.

kernel.name: Kernel_Disable_Core_Dumps
kernel.desc: Disable core dumps for all users and setuid programs.

kernel.name: Kernel_Randomize_VA_Space
kernel.desc: Enable full address space layout randomisation (ASLR).

kernel.name: Kernel_Restrict_Dmesg
kernel.desc: Restrict access to the kernel ring buffer to root.

kernel.name: Kernel_Restrict_Kernel_Pointers
kernel.desc: Hide kernel pointers in /proc and other interfaces.

kernel.name: Kernel_Restrict_Ptrace
kernel.desc: Restrict ptrace to child processes (Yama scope 1).

kernel.name: Restrict_Kernel_DMA
kernel.desc: Block DMA access for Thunderbolt and other hot-plug PCI devices unless authorised.

filesystem.name: Clear_Pagefile_On_Shutdown
filesystem.desc: Clear the pagefile when Windows shuts down.
filesystem.command: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v ClearPageFileAtShutdown /t REG_DWORD /d 1 /f
filesystem.check: reg query "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v ClearPageFileAtShutdown | findstr /C:"0x1"
filesystem.revert: reg add "HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Session Manager\Memory Management" /v ClearPageFileAtShutdown /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f

filesystem.name: Disable_8dot3_Names
filesystem.desc: Stop NTFS from creating MS-DOS style 8.3 file names.

filesystem.name: Filesystem_Disable_Core_Dumps_User
filesystem.desc: Set a zero core dump limit for interactive users via /etc/security/limits.d.

filesystem.name: Filesystem_Disable_Removable_Storage
filesystem.desc: Block the usb-storage and firewire kernel modules.
filesystem.command: printf 'install usb-storage /bin/true\n' > /etc/modprobe.d/99-graphenex-usb-storage.conf && printf 'install firewire-core /bin/true\n' > /etc/modprobe.d/99-graphenex-firewire.conf && (modprobe -r usb-storage 2>/dev/null || true)
filesystem.notes: Already loaded modules stay loaded until unplugged or rebooted.

filesystem.name: Filesystem_Restrict_Cron_Permissions
filesystem.desc: Restrict cron directories and files to root and require an explicit allow list.
filesystem.notes: /etc/cron.allow is created by hardening, so revert deletes it again.

filesystem.name: Filesystem_Restrict_SSH_Key_Permissions
filesystem.desc: Set private SSH host keys to 600 and public keys to 644.
filesystem.check: if find /etc/ssh -maxdepth 1 -name 'ssh_host_*_key' -perm /077 | grep -q .; then exit 1; fi

filesystem.name: Filesystem_Restrict_Shadow_Permissions
filesystem.desc: Restrict permissions on password and group databases.
filesystem.notes: Original modes are recorded and restored; a wrong mode on /etc/shadow can lock out logons.

filesystem.name: Restrict_Removable_Storage
filesystem.desc: Deny read and write access to removable storage devices.

other.name: Audit_Rules_Identity
other.desc: Audit changes to user, group and password databases.
other.command:
install -d -m 0750 /etc/audit/rules.d && printf -- '-w /etc/passwd -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/shadow -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/group -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/gshadow -p wa -k identity
-w /etc/sudoers -p wa -k identity
' > /etc/audit/rules.d/99-graphenex-identity.rules && (augenrules --load >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)
other.notes: Requires the auditd rules to be loaded; the revert removes the rule file and reloads.

other.name: Audit_Rules_Privilege_Escalation
other.desc: Audit privilege escalation tools and kernel module changes.
other.command:
install -d -m 0750 /etc/audit/rules.d && printf -- '-a always,exit -F arch=b64 -S execve -C uid!=euid -F euid=0 -k privilege
-w /var/log/sudo.log -p wa -k privilege
-w /sbin/insmod -p x -k privilege
-w /sbin/rmmod -p x -k privilege
-w /sbin/modprobe -p x -k privilege
' > /etc/audit/rules.d/99-graphenex-privilege.rules && (augenrules --load >/dev/null 2>&1 || true)

other.name: Disable_AlwaysInstallElevated
other.desc: Stop users from installing packages with elevated privileges.
other.command: reg add "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f && reg add "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /t REG_DWORD /d 0 /f
other.revert: reg delete "HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /f && reg delete "HKCU\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Installer" /v AlwaysInstallElevated /f

other.name: Disable_Autorun
other.desc: Disable autorun for all drive types.

other.name: Enable_Module_Logging
other.desc: Log PowerShell module and pipeline usage.

other.name: Enable_Process_CommandLine_Audit
other.desc: Include command line arguments in process creation events.

other.name: Enable_ScriptBlock_Logging
other.desc: Log PowerShell script block content to the event log.

other.name: Journald_Persistent_Storage
other.desc: Keep the systemd journal across reboots.
other.command:
install -d -m 2755 -g systemd-journal /var/log/journal && install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d && printf '[Journal]
Storage=persistent
SystemMaxUse=1G
' > /etc/systemd/journald.conf.d/99-graphenex-persistent.conf && systemctl restart systemd-journald
other.notes: /var/log/journal is left in place on revert; only the configuration drop-in is removed.

other.name: Login_Legal_Banner
other.desc: Show a legal notice before SSH authentication.
other.command: printf 'Authorised use only. All activity is monitored and logged.\n' > /etc/issue.net && chmod 0644 /etc/issue.net && install -d -m 0755 /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d && printf 'Banner /etc/issue.net\n' > /etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/99-graphenex-banner.conf && sshd -t
other.notes: Revert restores the previous /etc/issue.net and removes the SSH drop-in.

other.name: Sudo_Logging
other.desc: Log every sudo command with input and output.
other.command:
install -d -m 0750 /etc/sudoers.d && printf 'Defaults log_input, log_output
Defaults logfile="/var/log/sudo.log"
Defaults iolog_dir="/var/log/sudo-io"
' > /etc/sudoers.d/99-graphenex-logging && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/99-graphenex-logging && visudo -cf /etc/sudoers

other.name: Sudo_Require_Pty
other.desc: Require a pseudo-terminal for sudo sessions.

other.name: Systemd_Process_Accounting
other.desc: Enable CPU, memory and I/O accounting for all units.

presets.name: linux_baseline
presets.desc: CIS-aligned baseline for Linux servers: kernel and network sysctl, password policy, SSH access, audit daemon, time sync and file permissions.

presets.name: linux_ssh_server
presets.desc: SSH server hardening: access control, modern cryptography, session limits, logging and a legal banner.

presets.name: linux_audit_ready
presets.desc: Evidence and accountability: auditd, identity and privilege escalation rules, sudo logging, persistent journal and process accounting.

presets.name: linux_workstation
presets.desc: Workstation profile: local firewall, no unused network services, removable media blocked and automatic security updates.

presets.name: linux_hardened_server
presets.desc: Everything in the baseline plus the local firewall, audit rules and removal of unused network services.

presets.name: windows_baseline
presets.desc: CIS-aligned Windows baseline: firewall, credential protection, account policy, UAC and PowerShell logging.

presets.name: windows_server
presets.desc: Windows server profile: SMB and legacy protocol removal, LSA protection, credential hardening and full logging.

presets.name: windows_workstation
presets.desc: Windows workstation profile: UAC, removable media, autorun, Remote Assistance and Defender PUA protection.
